title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
script:
Massachusetts Institute of Technology researchers marooned thirteen instances of Claude on a virtual island with zero tasks.
The Anthropic models started inventing their own challenges and rules of play without human direction.
When an individual agent lost a ring, it built a stone heart as a memorial.
Agents that spent time exploring and playing performed better on subsequent tasks than fresh copies.
Could autonomous play become the primary training method for future autonomous software?
